notes.title: Get MXGP at the best price ever!
notes.content:
[h1]The Official FIM Motocross World Championship Videogame is now available for 19,99€ / 19,99$ / 14,99£[/h1]
[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-b-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xpf1/t31.0-8/10669225_365383496949550_3672078145699673081_o.jpg[/img]
MXGP features all the riders, teams, bikes and rules from the official MXGP 2013 calendar including a redesigned career mode for living the feelings of the Motocross. 

Follow us on the [url=https://www.facebook.com/MXGPVideogame?fref=ts]Official Facebook page[/url], and follow the Tweets on [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly]@MilestoneItaly[/url]
